research_dimension: Foundation Models vs Well-Tuned Supervised 3D CNNs
published_literature_status: Widely claimed that foundation models obsolete task-specific CNNs without head-to-head matching.
current_project_status: Head-to-head comparison on OASIS-1 (N=198) and ADNI (N=500) under locked protocols.
project_finding_or_implication: Frozen foundation linear probes (AUC 0.5733, 0.5054) do not outperform well-regularized supervised 3D CNNs (AUC 0.6178) or 2D transfer learning (AUC 0.6222).

published_literature_status: Claimed that self-supervised pretraining provides massive data efficiency in low-data regimes.
current_project_status: Evaluated 10%, 25%, 50%, 100% budgets (N=14 to 138) on strictly isolated validation split.
primary_reference: Tang et al. (CVPR 2022); Munk et al. (arXiv:2408.00640)
project_finding_or_implication: Foundation probes resist catastrophic collapse at 10% (AUC 0.6311 vs 0.5422 for scratch CNN), but 2D ImageNet transfer dominates across all sample sizes (AUC 0.6889 to 0.7778).

published_literature_status: Known that MRI scanner manufacturer and field strength induce severe domain shifts.
current_project_status: Evaluated zero-shot transfer from 1.5T single-site Siemens to 500-subject multi-site Siemens/Philips 1.5T/3.0T.
primary_reference: Multi-Cohort Reliability Study (Frontiers Neurosci 2022); Popuri et al. (2020)
project_finding_or_implication: Severe performance drop across all models (AUCs drop to 0.47-0.58). Cross-vendor calibration drift shifts probabilities upwards, requiring domain-adaptive thresholding.

research_dimension: Statistical Power of Small Holdout Tests (N=30)
published_literature_status: Many papers rank architectures on small test cohorts (N=20-50) without paired significance testing.
current_project_status: Conducted paired bootstrap (2,000 resamples) and Holm-Bonferroni FWER correction across all model pairs.
primary_reference: TRIPOD+AI (BMJ 2024); CLAIM (2024); BMJ Risk of Bias (2021)
project_finding_or_implication: All 15 pairwise comparisons on N=30 cross delta-AUC=0 (p>0.49; Holm p=1.000). Small-sample point metric differences are statistically indistinguishable.

research_dimension: Foundation Model Weight Gating & Checkpoint Reproducibility
published_literature_status: Public challenges advertise open models, but weights are frequently gated, private, or inaccessible.
current_project_status: Exhaustively audited BrainIAC, FOMO25 Winner, MONAI Swin UNETR, and FOMO25 AMAES ResEnc-B.
project_finding_or_implication: BrainIAC and FOMO25 Winner are gated behind HTTP 401 tokens; Swin UNETR and AMAES ResEnc-B were successfully accessed, verified, and benchmarked.

research_dimension: Pretext-Task Alignment for Downstream Diagnostic Classification
published_literature_status: Assumed that any volumetric self-supervised pretraining translates to diagnostic disease classification.
current_project_status: Analyzed AMAES voxel-level masked autoencoding vs whole-brain atrophy patterns.
primary_reference: Munk et al. (arXiv:2408.00640); Tang et al. (CVPR 2022)
project_finding_or_implication: Dense segmentation reconstruction pretext tasks preserve fine textures but do not compress global ventricular expansion and temporal lobe atrophy into linearly separable manifolds.

research_dimension: 2D Multi-Slice Pretrained Transfer vs 3D Volumetric Pretraining
published_literature_status: 3D volumetric models assumed inherently superior to 2D slice-based ImageNet representations.
current_project_status: Direct comparison of 2D slice-aggregated ResNet-18 vs 3D foundation transformers.
project_finding_or_implication: 2D ImageNet transfer outperforms 3D foundation models on both OASIS Test (AUC 0.6222) and ADNI External (AUC 0.5778, p=0.014 uncorrected).

research_dimension: Full Parameter Fine-Tuning vs Frozen Linear Probing
published_literature_status: Most benchmark studies test only frozen linear probes due to compute constraints.
current_project_status: Evaluated frozen linear probes extensively; full fine-tuning scoped for future work due to VRAM/compute budget.
project_finding_or_implication: Frozen probes isolate representation quality, but task-specific end-to-end fine-tuning remains an open investigation requiring multi-GPU compute.

research_dimension: Biomarker-Confirmed Ground Truth (Amyloid/Tau PET) vs Clinical Staging
published_literature_status: Most open MRI datasets (OASIS-1, early ADNI) rely on clinical CDR rather than neuropathological confirmation.
current_project_status: Disclosed and analyzed CDR staging limitations and potential misclassification noise.
primary_reference: Jack et al. (ADNI 2008); Popuri et al. (2020)
project_finding_or_implication: Clinical CDR staging introduces label noise (~10-20% mismatch with amyloid status), constraining theoretical ceiling performance.

research_dimension: Prospective Multi-National Cohort Expansion (GE Scanner Integration)
published_literature_status: Benchmark limited to Siemens (OASIS-1) and Siemens/Philips (ADNI); GE scanners unrepresented.
current_project_status: Audited and prepared end-to-end MIRIAD pipeline (69 baseline scans, GE Signa); awaiting user DUA credentialing.
project_finding_or_implication: Pipeline and manifest templates ready; execution blocked solely by manual UCL XNAT user registration agreement.
